genesis_anchor_score_floor.default: Field(default=0.55, ge=0.0, le=1.0, description='Minimum survival or exact-critical score for first-turn genesis anchoring.')

genesis_anchor_turns.default: Field(default=2, ge=0, description='Initial turns treated as durable planning/concept context. High-value spans from these turns are protected by adaptive budget gates.')

memory_budget_mode.default: Field(default='adaptive', description='How hot-memory budget is resolved. fixed uses explicit token caps, ratio uses context_window_tokens * memory_context_ratio, and adaptive uses the smallest quality-gated budget within the allowed context.')

memory_context_ratio.default: Field(default=None, gt=0.0, lt=1.0, description='Optional soft fraction of the model context window that hot memory may use. The explicit hot_token_budget remains a floor, so small ratios do not force destructive compression.')

recent_tail_token_budget.default: Field(default=0, ge=0, description='Tokens reserved for recent transcript tail outside hot memory.')

target_token_reduction.default: Field(default=None, gt=0.0, lt=1.0, description='Preferred compression target. For example, 0.90 means try to keep memory near 10% of extracted span tokens, but expand when quality gates would otherwise fail.')

heatmap_format.default: Field(default='none', description="When ``'data'`` or ``'html'`` the rollup also emits a conversation-level heatmap (session signals + top dead files + reason-code histogram) ready to render.")

scores.default: Field(default=None, description='Subset of ``GroundednessScores`` fields. At minimum the transform reads ``groundedness_v2`` / ``composite_phantom_score`` / ``dead_weight_ratio`` / ``dead_weight_file_count``.')

cascade_density.default: Field(default=0.0, description='Fraction of turns that triggered the NLI cascade. A sustained value > 0.5 suggests the session has entered an ambiguous regime.')

dead_file_candidates.default: Field(default_factory=list, description="Files whose EMA owner_share has stayed below the dead-weight threshold for at least 5 consecutive turns. Safe to evict from the agent's context window.")

dead_weight_streak.default: Field(default=0, description='Length of the longest active dead-turn run across tracked files.')

drift_z_score.default: Field(default=0.0, description="Absolute per-session z-score of the current ``per_token_p10`` against the session's rolling baseline. A value >= 2.0 is a strong drift signal.")

ema_groundedness.default: Field(default=None, description='EMA of the turn-level groundedness headline over the session.')

groundedness_drift.default: Field(default=0.0, description='``ema_groundedness - baseline_mean`` where the baseline is the mean of the first ~10 turns. Negative = session is degrading vs its early behaviour.')

phantom_rate.default: Field(default=0.0, description='Rolling fraction of turns flagged ``ast_phantom_verdict=True``.')

recommendation.default: Field(default='continue', description='Session-level recommendation derived from the signals above. One of ``continue``, ``re-anchor``, ``fresh-chat``.')

red_streak.default: Field(default=0, description='Trailing count of consecutive ``red`` risk-band turns.')

schema_version.default: Field(default=1, description='Session-state schema version. Bumped on breaking changes.')

session_id.default: Field(default=None, description='Opaque session identifier. Not used for lookup — just echoed.')
